clue.text: Concoction of Buck's Fizz and dodgy vodka befell meanie

indicators.note: something dodgy is unreliable or crooked, so the letters of the following words are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A recipe: the famous brunch cocktail, but made with dubious vodka, and the mean drinker regrets it.
explanation.walkthrough: Bucks Fizz was a British pop group (Eurovision winners in 1981), and this song was one of their hits; the cocktail is the misdirection. 'dodgy' rearranges VODKA, BEFELL and MEANIE, seventeen letters exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1981 hit single by the pop group Bucks Fizz carries this title, so it is something the band concocted.

definitions.meaning: said twice over, it names the fantasy land of Peter Pan as some call it

explanation.definitionFit: Not once means at no time; doubled, the word names Peter Pan's imaginary island, Never-Never Land.
